body:
Controversial! 

Suggest requirement for Level 3 to have any external library hosted locally to prevent any hijacking through third party server compromise?

E.g. calling javascript libraries such as jquery (probably bad example, but lesser known/supported ones certainly) should be hosted locally to avoid their compromise affecting your apps.

comments.body: Hmm.  I think the problem is more about trustiness of the library than where it comes. This would impact CDN delivery of large scale web apps, and I don't think that is okay.

title: V19.8 - external components - hosting?
